about.title: About the data
about.body:
Every number comes from the official sources listed below. The site does not change them; it only presents them in a readable form. Where a figure has not been published, the site says so and estimates nothing.

The state budget is only part of public finances. It does not include, for example, the budgets of municipalities, the Social Insurance Agency or health insurers.

glossary: The state's plan of revenue and spending for one year. Parliament passes it as a law.
The part of the budget one institution is responsible for, such as a ministry, office or court.
The amount parliament approved at the start of the year.
The budget after changes made during the year by the government or the Ministry of Finance.
Money the state actually paid out. During the year it is the total since 1 January.
A chapter managed by the Ministry of Finance. It pays, for example, interest on state debt, contributions to the EU budget and grants to local governments.
